description.value: Kings Links Clubhouse is the restaurant at Kings Links Golf Course, a seaside par-72 championship links course in Tsawwassen recognized by Golf Canada as one of Canada's best links-style courses. The clubhouse features a patio with spectacular views of the golf course, Coast Mountains, Mount Baker, and the Gulf Islands. The restaurant is explicitly open to the public, not just members or golfers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Kings Links is an active golf course clubhouse with a restaurant explicitly 'open to the public,' matching the OSM amenity=restaurant tag. The address (3388 72nd St, Delta, BC V4K 3N2) and website URL both corroborate OSM data; phone numbers appear on the website but are absent from OSM tags. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists 604.952.0999 and 1.877.546.5710.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant at a public golf course clubhouse, explicitly open to the public per the website.
enrichment_extras.notes: The restaurant is part of the Kings Links Golf Course clubhouse but is stated to be open to the public, making it accessible to touring cyclists seeking food and drink.
